newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Coal & Allied says 1st qtr profit ahead.
newsitem.headline: Coal & Allied says 1st qtr profit ahead.

text.p: Coal and Allied Industries Ltd, majority owned by international mining house RTZ Plc-CRA Ltd, said on Friday that its calendar 1997 first quarter profit was ahead of the year-ago result.
The company also said it did not believe that RTZ-CRA would sell its majority stake of 71 percent.
"The intent is to make them work and perform," he said, adding this view had been communicated to him by RTZ-CRA.
The company's mining operations are based in the Hunter Valley region, located just north of Sydney in the state of New South Wales.
Coal and Allied made a loss of A$4.58 million in the first six months of calendar 1996 and last month revealed a full year slump in net profit to A$4.06 million from A$41.99 million in 1995.

Chairman David Klingner told shareholders at the annual meeting that profitability in the immediate period would be under pressure due to lower prices for semi-coking and thermal coal deliveries to Japan in the 1996/97 year which began April 1.
